episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Shion has successfully booted the upgraded mass biometric analytical  system for locating Momo Yozakura, Old Man Hunter 2. While she searches, Taiyo attempts to take his skills to the next level so that he can hold his own against Momo. Thanks to Kyoichiro's spartan training and Kai's support, Taiyo discovers his own way of fighting while manifesting Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers. Just then, Shion reports that she's pinpointed Momo's location! The Yozakuras and the Gold Rank spies mobilize to bring Futaba and Shinzo home!
